name: media.get_playing_title
precondition: None - reports current state with no caller obligations.
postcondition: Makes NO state changes. Returns the current media-title property of the running mpv player, or None if no player is reachable. Distinct from media.play/play_for, which start playback.
failure_mode: Never raises: a missing or unreachable mpv player is reported as None, not an error. An mpv IPC reply that lacks a title value or carries an error is also treated as None.
returns: str | None - the current media title (mpv 'media-title' property), or None when no player responds or the property is unavailable.
